character: Viltri Quay is the lake's rescue port: its Pokemon are freshwater ones that work boats, piers, nets and the relief office, and the rest are lake-shore life that treats the town as part of the bank (crabs under the rescue boat, a dam behind the library, a family crossing the promenade). Fresh water only: nothing from the sea coast at Sunset West.
authored_by: town author A, 2026-10-05, by hand; positions measured from derived/towns/gym2_town_plan.json, gym2_town_placement.json, derived/plaza_centres/gym2_town.json and tools/ground.py (rounded) through tools/ambient.py's Site; y in a situation is the standing y (ground, or the plaza's paved y 107, + 1). No worker stands on the plaza: the plaza is cut a block below the heightmap there, and Site would stand a worker on the uncut ground

workers.interact: The Timburr shoulders a plank as long as itself down to the east pier, where the Scyther is cutting the new keel.
The boatwright's Scyther shaves the keel plank in long curls. It stops, sights along it, and shaves again.
The Buizel runs the morning's catch up from the water's edge one fish at a time, dripping all the way.
The quay's Floatzel watches the swimmers off the west pier with its float half inflated. It glares at the Golduck in its chair.
The Wooper mops the promenade by lying on it and rolling. The flagstones behind it shine.
The fisher's Corphish picks the knots out of the nets hung on the cottage's back wall, snipping the ones it cannot pick.
The relief clerk's Swablu carries the day's lists of the missing to the library to be copied. It holds the page in its beak, very carefully.
The Quagsire scoops the silt out of the shallows so the rescue boat can get in. It does not seem to mind which way the silt goes.
The Mudkip keeps the moored rowing boat's bilge empty, spitting each mouthful back over the side.
The Poliwhirl turns the winch that hauls boats up past the east pier, its belly swirl turning with the drum.
The Lombre sweeps the avenue by the Mart with the pad on its head, humming.

pets.why: the relief clerk's Marill follows her between the desk and the square, its tail float bobbing behind
and an Azurill that waits by the desk, sitting on its own tail, because it cannot keep up
the rescue-gear seller's Dewpider, in its bubble, next to the diving helmets: a sales pitch
the boatwright's Chewtle follows him and bites every plank he picks up, to test it
the fishmonger's Skitty waits by the fish with enormous patience
the strange-catch seller's Surskit skates in circles in a bucket of lake water by the stall

placed.why: a Shellos in the gutter after rain, as if the gutter were a stream
a Tympole in the gutter of the end house, humming in the drainpipe
a Lotad on the mason's step, keeping its pad wet in a puddle
a Pidgey on the library roof
a Minccino on the fisher's step, dusting it with its tail
a Froakie on the tannery step, its froth drying in the sun
a Taillow on the cartographer's roof, facing into the wind off the lake
a Wynaut on the farmhouse step, swaying, waiting to be noticed
a Ledyba on the mason's wall top, warming up before it flies

situations.title: Right of way
situations.story: A Swanna leads five Ducklett across the promenade from the lake to the farm's puddle, in a line, at their pace. Nobody on the promenade moves until the last one is over.
situations.why: on the promenade's east end (street cells 2854-2858) between the east pier and gym2_house_07; the gap before the last Ducklett is the straggler

situations.title: Tenants of the rescue boat
situations.story: Four Krabby have moved in under the edges of the rescue boat in the square and pinch the ankles of anyone who sits on it to rest.
situations.why: round gym2_rescue_hull (columns x 1630-1636, z 2806-2808 in derived/plaza_centres/gym2_town.json), never on its blocks

situations.title: The dam behind the library
situations.story: A Bibarel has been damming the drain behind the library for a week and two Bidoof keep bringing it sticks. The library cellar is starting to flood.
situations.why: the library's (gym2_house_06) back, its north side, outside its lot

situations.title: Gone fishing
situations.story: Four Poliwag sit in a row at the water's edge east of the gym with their tails in the lake, exactly like the anglers on the pier. Nothing has bitten.
situations.why: the shore below the east lawn, y105, outside the water export's margin

situations.title: The lifeguard's chair
situations.story: A Golduck sits in the lifeguard's tall chair at the west pier every day. The real lifeguard, a Floatzel, works from the ground and has stopped arguing.
situations.why: the west pier's landward end, beside the Floatzel's station

notes: Supersedes idle.towns.gym2_town (Slowpoke, Snorlax and Purrloin are gone; Psyduck is left out on purpose because the owner's brief used it as the example and the other author may too). Eleven workers (three carriers) is over data/ambient.json rules.per_town (2 carriers, 4 stationary).
